hero.title: Your Privacy & Safety Come First
hero.description: At Netsanet, protecting survivor privacy and data security is our highest priority. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

principles.title: Our Privacy Principles
principles.description: These core principles guide every decision we make about your data.

items.title: Safety First
items.description: Your safety is paramount. We never share survivor data with unauthorized parties.

items.title: End-to-End Encryption
items.description: All communications and evidence are encrypted. Even we cannot access your private messages.

items.title: Anonymous Option
items.description: You can report cases anonymously. Your identity remains hidden unless you choose to reveal it.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: We clearly explain what data we collect, why we collect it, and how it's used.

items.title: Minimal Data
items.description: We only collect information necessary to provide support services.

items.title: Your Control
items.description: You control your data. Request access, corrections, or deletion at any time.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.description: We collect only what's necessary to provide you with safe, effective support services.

items.title: Account Information
details: Email address for authentication via one-time password (OTP)
User role and institution assignment (for case workers and admins)

items.title: Case Information
details: Incident details including date, location, and description
Evidence files and encrypted communication with case workers

items.title: Provide Support Services
items.description: Connect you with case workers, legal aid, and support institutions.

items.title: Case Management
items.description: Track case progress, coordinate referrals, and facilitate communication.

items.title: AI-Powered Assistance
items.description: Provide risk assessment, case prioritization, and legal guidance through our AI systems.

items.title: Security & Safety
items.description: Detect and prevent unauthorized access, fraud, and abuse of the platform.

items.title: Service Improvement
items.description: Analyze anonymized usage patterns to improve platform features and user experience.

items.title: Legal Compliance
items.description: Comply with Ethiopian laws and respond to valid legal requests (with survivor notification when possible).

warning.title: Important: Limited Sharing
warning.description: We NEVER sell your data. We only share information with authorized parties necessary for your support and safety.

items.title: Assigned Case Workers
items.description: Your assigned case worker can access case details to provide support. Anonymous cases hide your identity.

items.title: Partner Institutions
items.description: When you consent to a referral, relevant case information is shared with the receiving institution (e.g., legal aid, medical facility).

items.title: System Administrators
items.description: AASTU technical staff have limited access for system maintenance and security. They are bound by strict confidentiality agreements.

items.title: Law Enforcement (Only When Required)
items.description: We may be legally required to share information in response to valid court orders. We will notify you unless prohibited by law.

items.title: AI Service Providers
items.description: Google Gemini processes case data for risk assessment. Data is anonymized and encrypted. Google does not store or use this data for other purposes.

rights.title: Your Privacy Rights

items.title: Access Your Information
items.description: View your account information and case details through your dashboard.

items.title: Update Case Information
items.description: Correct or update information in your reported cases as needed.

items.title: Anonymous Reporting
items.description: Report cases anonymously to protect your identity while receiving support.

items.title: Request Data Deletion
items.description: Contact us to request account deletion (subject to legal retention requirements for active cases).

rights.contact: For privacy-related requests or concerns, contact us at

security.title: How We Protect Your Data
security.description: Multiple layers of security ensure your information stays safe and confidential.

items.title: Encryption
items.description: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest (AES-256). Evidence files are stored in encrypted containers.

items.title: Access Controls
items.description: Role-based access ensures only authorized personnel can view specific data. All access is logged and audited.

items.title: Secure Infrastructure
items.description: Data is stored on secure servers with regular backups, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems.

items.title: Regular Audits
items.description: We conduct regular security audits and penetration testing to identify and fix vulnerabilities.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.description: We retain your data only as long as necessary to provide services and comply with legal obligations.

items.label: Account data
items.duration: Retained while account is active + 1 year after deletion request
